project.name: Project Example Foundry
project.outcome: Deliver a maintainable internal capability through evidence-bearing phases without losing purpose, authority, or completion state.

source_authority.locator: Anonymized current owner correction and milestone authority
source_authority.scope: M0 completion, local checkpoint authority, and the boundary before M1

hierarchy.label: Phase 4
hierarchy.purpose: Build and prove the internal capability through governed milestones.

hierarchy.label: M0 - Internal foundation cut
hierarchy.purpose: Establish a verified and locally checkpointed foundation for later work.

hierarchy.label: M1 - First capability slice
hierarchy.purpose: Begin the first capability slice only after M0 closeout is accepted.

current.purpose_connection: M0 makes a verified, durable foundation available for controlled Phase 4 delivery.
current.next_action: Complete the M0 closeout review; start M1 only after that closeout is accepted.

non_goals: Replacing the roadmap with implementation detail

grants.scope: M0 local implementation and checkpoint actions
may_not: Create a local checkpoint without later permission
grants.rationale: A self-authored caution separated implementation from repository mutation but made local completion unreachable.
grants.revisit_trigger: The owner clarifies the terminal state or the safeguard blocks completion.

grants.scope: M0 build, verification, local checkpoint, and the transition boundary into M1
may: Create the verified local M0 checkpoint
may_not: Synchronize the remote without separate authority
grants.rationale: The owner requires a durable local milestone while retaining remote and transition authority.
grants.revisit_trigger: M0 closeout is accepted or repository authority changes.

work_packages.outcome: Produce a sound, verified, and locally checkpointed M0 foundation.
work_packages.next_action: Submit the evidenced M0 baseline for closeout before activating M1.

exit_criteria.description: The complete M0 foundation exists in the canonical local workspace.
The named M0 verification passes against the intended baseline.
An authorized durable local checkpoint records the verified M0 baseline.

completion_contract.definition: M0 is complete when BUILT, VERIFIED, and LOCALLY_CHECKPOINTED are evidenced; REMOTE_SYNCHRONIZED is optional and may remain pending.

decisions.decision: M0 requires an authorized local checkpoint; remote synchronization is optional, and M1 begins only after M0 closeout.
options: Authorize local checkpoint and reserve remote sync
decisions.rationale: This makes milestone completion durable without expanding authority into remote mutation.

changes.request: Replace the self-authored no-checkpoint restriction with the owner-authorized local-checkpoint boundary.

impact.scope: No product scope change; completion authority is clarified.
impact.schedule: Removes an artificial blocker without advancing M1.
impact.cost: No material cost change in this example.
impact.risk: Remote control remains reserved while local completion becomes explicit.
impact.quality: The checkpoint is tied to the verified M0 baseline.
impact.benefits: Creates a durable transition point for Phase 4.
